summary: Iteration 34 '1% Perfection Finale' backend testing: 25/25 pytest tests pass against live preview backend covering Survival Pantry (CRUD + alerts + OCR scan + _detect_expiry regex unit tests), Impact Dashboard (shape + Physio-AI top_thread seed), Silent Witness (session lifecycle, chunk validation, close idempotency), Streak Save-Freeze (weekly cap + 409 replay), Blazing Badge celebrated flag, Angel Pulse (send/inbox/felt with guardian-link enforcement + self/stranger 400/403 guards), plus regression on /api/achievements (8 badges), /api/streaks/physio flags, /api/voice/tts (onyx). All new endpoints work as designed.

minor.issue: Response shape uses `unlocked`/`locked` (not `badges` array). Not a bug — flagged so future tests use the correct keys. Total=8 confirmed.

critical_code_review_comments: pantry.py: `_detect_expiry` regex works for MHD MM/YYYY, Spotreba do DD.MM.YYYY, Best before ISO. Consider adding DD/MM/YY variant and Slovak 'DMT' (Dátum minimálnej trvanlivosti) label.

silent_witness.py: successive close on same session returns 404 (find_one_and_update filter includes status:'active'). Test expected 404, matches. However user request said 'closing already-closed session → 404' — implementation correct.

family.py angel_pulse_send: 'Recipient not found' returns 404 rather than 400 for missing user; user request said 'unrelated recipient → 403' which is enforced only when user exists but is not linked. Both branches verified.

impact.py: `hasattr(db, 'wellness_vitals')` etc. always returns True on Motor's AsyncIOMotorDatabase (attributes are lazy-created), so those counts always run. Not a bug but the guard is misleading — consider explicitly listing collection names or using `collection_names()`.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral seeds inserted+deleted per test: TEST_-prefixed pantry rows, one impact physio_video (seeded_test:True), one fake vault document for pantry/scan, one stranger user for angel/pulse 403 branch, phantom is_freeze physio row cleaned before/after freeze tests, blazing_celebration marker cleaned. All fixtures have teardown; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter34_perfection.py -n 0 -v`. Uses smoketok-fresh-2026 (u1) + smoketok-fresh-2026-u2 (u2) which are guardian-linked (u1→u2). If freeze test runs at very end of ISO week and rolls into new week between calls, it could false-pass — but the autouse fixture resets db.streak_freezes each test so this is safe. Achievements endpoint returns `{unlocked, locked, unlocked_count, total}` not `{badges}` — future tests should use that shape.
rca_of_issue: n/a — all issues from the feature scope verified working.
